definitions.explanation: An instrument used for attacking or defending in combat.
Something used as a means to achieve a goal or gain advantage.

examples.japanese: {核|かく}{武器|ぶき}の{廃絶|はいぜつ}を{訴|うった}える。
examples.english: To advocate for the abolition of nuclear weapons.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{武器|ぶき}は{語学力|ごがくりょく}だ。
examples.english: Her asset is her language ability.

notes:
USAGE: {武器|ぶき} can refer to physical weapons or figuratively to personal strengths or advantages.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{武器|ぶき}を{持|も}つ (to carry a weapon)
・{武器|ぶき}を{使|つか}う (to use a weapon)
・{武器|ぶき}にする (to use as a weapon/advantage)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{核|かく}{武器|ぶき} (nuclear weapons)
・{化学|かがく}{武器|ぶき} (chemical weapons)
・{生物|せいぶつ}{武器|ぶき} (biological weapons)
・{武器庫|ぶきこ} (armory)
